target.title: fix: protect uncovered cleanup window in runCodexAppServerAttempt (#99271)
target.body:
## Summary

`runCodexAppServerAttempt` in `extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.ts` has an uncovered exception window between turn acceptance (line ~2938) and the main cleanup `finally` (line ~3100). If `attachBackend()` or `setActiveEmbeddedRun()` throws synchronously in this window:

- Notification/request handlers stay registered on the shared pooled client
- The shared-client lease is never released
- `clearActiveEmbeddedRun` never runs, leaving a phantom active-run handle

### Change

Move `attachBackend` + `setActiveEmbeddedRun` inside a `try` block (before the main `finally`), so any synchronous throw in this window releases the shared-client lease before propagating.

## Test plan

- [x] **Inject test** (`run-attempt.cleanup-inject.test.ts`): patches `replyOperation.attachBackend` to throw synchronously, asserts the attempt rejects and the shared-client lease cleanup path runs
- [x] `run-attempt.dynamic-tools.test.ts` (8 tests) — passed
- [x] `run-attempt.hooks.test.ts` (21 tests) — passed  
- [x] `run-attempt.native-hook-relay.test.ts` (18 tests) — passed
- [x] `attempt-client-cleanup.test.ts` (2 tests) — passed
- [x] `run-attempt.cleanup-inject.test.ts` (1 test) — passed

## Evidence

**L2 — local vitest inject test**

The inject test proves both bug existence and fix effectiveness on the real `runCodexAppServerAttempt` function with a mock client:

```bash
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.cleanup-inject.test.ts

 RUN  v4.1.8 E:/Projects/skills/work/openclaw

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (1)
```

Before the fix: `attachBackend` throwing leaves the shared-client lease unreleased, `clearActiveEmbeddedRun` never runs.

After the fix: the try/catch around `attachBackend` + `setActiveEmbeddedRun` releases `releaseSharedClientLeaseAndRetireOneShotClient()` before rethrowing, preventing resource leaks.

## Root cause

`setActiveEmbeddedRun` (line 3053) and `params.replyOperation?.attachBackend` (line 3052) were placed _after_ the `try` that owns the cleanup `finally` (line 3099). Any synchronous throw between lines 3052–3097 propagated without cleanup.

## Expected vs actual behavior

| Scenario | Before | After |
|----------|--------|-------|
| `attachBackend` throws in uncovered window | Leak: lease not released, active run not cleared | ✅ lease released, error propagated |
| `setActiveEmbeddedRun` throws in uncovered window | Leak: lease not released | ✅ lease released, error propagated |

## Impact

Prevents handler/lease leaks on the shared Codex app-server pooled client when post-turn-accept setup fails. The change is a ~4-line protection boundary — no refactor, no disposer stack.

## Proof limitations

No live Codex attempt was executed. The evidence is a vitest inject test on the real function with a mock client — this is L2 (source-repro + inject test on real code), not L3 (live failing attempt).

## Linked issues

- Fixes #99271
